summary: Held the entire window -- this SHORT worked from the first minute (px +41.75 by t=1m) and kept expanding to a peak of about +116pts around t=16-17m before giving back roughly two-thirds into the high-40s/low-50s by t=23-27m. At no point did price approach or threaten the entry level (0), so there was never a wrong-direction signature to act on -- the pullbacks were profit-taking/consolidation inside a strongly favorable trade, not reversal. Next time I'd watch for the giveback ratio approaching or exceeding 100% of the CURRENT leg combined with px approaching zero (not just off a local peak) as the real wrong-direction tell, since a leg giveback spike alone (e.g. 133-140% seen mid-episode) didn't correspond to actual risk to the entry level.
